about_the_game:
Your chicken has been taken. They will pay.

You were just a "simple farmer", until monsters raided your land and took your last companion: your chicken. Now, fueled by fury and a surprising knack for combat, you’ll journey across a wild and dangerous world to bring your feathery friend home.

Key Features:

Infuse Weapons with Elemental Power
Master the elements and channel fire, water, and more into your weapons, or even your fists! Switch and combine elements and weapons to discover powerful synergies and combat strategies.

Unpredictable Hordes, Fast-Paced Combat
Enemies don’t play fair. Dodge, counter, and unleash devastating attacks against chaotic, ever-changing enemy formations that keep every encounter fresh.

Traverse with Style
Leap over rooftops, wall-jump through ruins, and chain together parkour moves in fluid motion. Movement is your greatest weapon, and your only way out.

An Unlikely Quest, A Relentless Farmer
This isn’t just about a chicken. It’s about heart, grit, and a man who refuses to give up. Uncover secrets, upgrade your skills, and push forward, one punch at a time.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3220 or AMD FX-4100
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated audio, compatible with DirectX 10
  • VR Support: N/A

short_description: A humble farmer sets out to rescue his chicken from monstrous abductors. Punch, slash, and parkour your way through elemental-infused chaos in this fast-paced 2D action-platformer!
